cleanup_event_valid.name: cleanup_event_valid
cleanup_event_valid.value: char_length("cleanup_events"."title") between 3 and 100 and char_length("cleanup_events"."location") between 3 and 200 and char_length("cleanup_events"."instructions") between 10 and 2000 and "cleanup_events"."ends_at">"cleanup_events"."starts_at" and "cleanup_events"."points" between 2 and 10000 and "cleanup_events"."capacity" between 1 and 10000 and "cleanup_events"."status" in ('published','cancelled')

participant_valid.name: participant_valid
participant_valid.value: "cleanup_participants"."status" in ('joined','completed','rejected','cancelled') and char_length("cleanup_participants"."review_note")<=1000 and (("cleanup_participants"."status" in ('joined','cancelled') and "cleanup_participants"."reviewed_by" is null and "cleanup_participants"."reviewed_at" is null) or ("cleanup_participants"."status" not in ('joined','cancelled') and "cleanup_participants"."reviewed_by" is not null and "cleanup_participants"."reviewed_at" is not null and char_length("cleanup_participants"."review_note")>=8))

schedule_time_window_valid.name: schedule_time_window_valid
schedule_time_window_valid.value:
"collection_schedules"."start_time" < "collection_schedules"."end_time"
    and "collection_schedules"."end_time" < time '24:00' and extract(second from "collection_schedules"."start_time") = 0
    and extract(second from "collection_schedules"."end_time") = 0

schedule_weekdays_valid.name: schedule_weekdays_valid
schedule_weekdays_valid.value:
cardinality("collection_schedules"."weekdays") between 1 and 7
    and array_ndims("collection_schedules"."weekdays") = 1 and array_lower("collection_schedules"."weekdays", 1) = 1
    and "collection_schedules"."weekdays" <@ array[1,2,3,4,5,6,7]::integer[]
    and array_position("collection_schedules"."weekdays", null) is null
    and (cardinality("collection_schedules"."weekdays") < 2 or "collection_schedules"."weekdays"[1] < "collection_schedules"."weekdays"[2])
    and (cardinality("collection_schedules"."weekdays") < 3 or "collection_schedules"."weekdays"[2] < "collection_schedules"."weekdays"[3])
    and (cardinality("collection_schedules"."weekdays") < 4 or "collection_schedules"."weekdays"[3] < "collection_schedules"."weekdays"[4])
    and (cardinality("collection_schedules"."weekdays") < 5 or "collection_schedules"."weekdays"[4] < "collection_schedules"."weekdays"[5])
    and (cardinality("collection_schedules"."weekdays") < 6 or "collection_schedules"."weekdays"[5] < "collection_schedules"."weekdays"[6])
    and (cardinality("collection_schedules"."weekdays") < 7 or "collection_schedules"."weekdays"[6] < "collection_schedules"."weekdays"[7])

claim_valid.name: claim_valid
claim_valid.value: ("disposal_claims"."after_id" is null or "disposal_claims"."before_id"<>"disposal_claims"."after_id") and "disposal_claims"."request_id"<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid and char_length("disposal_claims"."location") between 3 and 200 and char_length("disposal_claims"."description") between 10 and 2000 and "disposal_claims"."points" between 1 and 10000 and "disposal_claims"."status" in ('pending','approved','rejected') and char_length("disposal_claims"."review_note")<=1000 and (("disposal_claims"."status"='pending' and "disposal_claims"."reviewed_by" is null and "disposal_claims"."reviewed_at" is null) or ("disposal_claims"."status"<>'pending' and "disposal_claims"."reviewed_at" is not null and char_length("disposal_claims"."review_note")>=8))

event_shape_valid.name: event_shape_valid
event_shape_valid.value:
(
    "report_events"."event_type" = 'created' and "report_events"."visibility" = 'resident'
    and "report_events"."previous_status" is null and "report_events"."next_status" is not null and "report_events"."next_status" = 'pending_review'
  ) or (
    "report_events"."event_type" = 'internal_note' and "report_events"."visibility" = 'internal'
    and "report_events"."previous_status" is null and "report_events"."next_status" is null and char_length("report_events"."note") >= 1
  ) or (
    "report_events"."event_type" = 'status_changed' and "report_events"."visibility" = 'resident'
    and "report_events"."previous_status" is not null and "report_events"."next_status" is not null
    and (("report_events"."previous_status" = 'pending_review' and "report_events"."next_status" in ('in_progress','resolved'))
      or ("report_events"."previous_status" = 'in_progress' and "report_events"."next_status" = 'resolved')
      or ("report_events"."previous_status" = 'resolved' and "report_events"."next_status" = 'in_progress'))
    and (("report_events"."next_status" <> 'resolved' and "report_events"."previous_status" <> 'resolved') or char_length("report_events"."note") >= 8)
  )

media_shape_valid.name: media_shape_valid
media_shape_valid.value: "resident_media"."state" = 'deleted' or ("resident_media"."kind" = 'disposal_photo' and "resident_media"."report_id" is null and "resident_media"."label" is null and "resident_media"."score" is null and "resident_media"."model_version" is null) or ("resident_media"."kind" = 'report_photo' and "resident_media"."report_id" is not null and "resident_media"."label" is null and "resident_media"."score" is null and "resident_media"."model_version" is null) or ("resident_media"."kind" = 'scan' and "resident_media"."report_id" is null and "resident_media"."label" is not null and "resident_media"."label" in ('glass','metal','non-recyclable','organic','paper','plastic') and "resident_media"."score" is not null and "resident_media"."score" ~ '^(0([.][0-9]{1,8})?|1([.]0{1,8})?)$' and "resident_media"."model_version" is not null and "resident_media"."model_version" = 'mobilenetv2-d0744dc70738-v1')

reward_catalog_valid.name: reward_catalog_valid
reward_catalog_valid.value: char_length("reward_catalog"."name") between 3 and 100 and char_length("reward_catalog"."description") between 10 and 1000 and "reward_catalog"."cost" between 1 and 1000000 and "reward_catalog"."stock" >= 0

reward_rules_valid.name: reward_rules_valid
reward_rules_valid.value: "reward_rules"."id"=1 and "reward_rules"."disposal_points" between 1 and 1000 and "reward_rules"."cleanup_points" > "reward_rules"."disposal_points" and "reward_rules"."cleanup_points" <= 10000 and "reward_rules"."daily_claim_limit" between 1 and 10

scan_config_valid.name: scan_config_valid
scan_config_valid.value: "scan_reward_config"."id"=1 and "scan_reward_config"."daily_awards" between 1 and 10 and "scan_reward_config"."daily_points" between 1 and 1000 and "scan_reward_config"."hourly_starts" between 1 and 20 and "scan_reward_config"."daily_starts" between 1 and 50

scan_reward_valid.name: scan_reward_valid
scan_reward_valid.value: "scan_reward_sessions"."request_id"<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid and "scan_reward_sessions"."fingers" between 1 and 3 and "scan_reward_sessions"."points" between 1 and 1000 and "scan_reward_sessions"."expires_at">"scan_reward_sessions"."created_at" and "scan_reward_sessions"."attempts" between 0 and 3 and "scan_reward_sessions"."status" in ('capture','pending','review','approved','rejected') and ("scan_reward_sessions"."before_id" is null or "scan_reward_sessions"."after_id" is null or "scan_reward_sessions"."before_id"<>"scan_reward_sessions"."after_id")
